instruction: A monumental stone statue on a large pedestal: a massive standing robed human figure with a simplified silhouette and blocky carved masses, atop a stepped stone plinth. Ground-visible massing, weathered stone.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a monumental stone statue. A monumental stone statue on a large pedestal: a massive standing robed human figure with a simplified silhouette and blocky carved masses, atop a stepped stone plinth. Ground-visible massing, weathered stone. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
